verdict.rationale: Polar documents recurring subscriptions that renew automatically each billing period. It also documents configurable proration, set at the organization level or per API call, which implies support for plan changes, along with automatic seat proration. Free trials are not evidenced anywhere in the pack, and upgrade/downgrade flows are only implied by the proration docs. missing for 10: documented free-trial support, explicit plan upgrade/downgrade docs, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can set up recurring subscription billing with plans, trials, upgrades, and proration

citations.quote: Polar renews it automatically. At the end of each billing period, Polar advances the subscription to the next cycle and creates a new order
You pick the proration behavior either at the organization level (as the default) or per API call.
Add, remove and prorate seats automatically.
Sell digital products, subscriptions, and more without the hassle of traditional payment systems.
